verdict.rationale: Firebase's Emulator Suite provides an isolated local environment for testing changes (Firestore, Auth, Functions) without touching production data, and the MCP server lets an AI agent interact with Firestore data/projects — together these could let an agent test changes safely. However, Firestore is schemaless so there's no dedicated 'schema migration' feature, and there is no documented branch/preview-environment concept (like ephemeral cloud environments) that an agent can spin up and tear down programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit branch/preview environment tooling, agent-driven workflow for creating/testing schema-like changes in an isolated cloud (not just local emulator) environment, and any independent evidence this is used this way.
